quest.title: Report back
quest.description: After finding the missing young detective, you bring him back to the Police Station...

chapter.num: Hangout Event: Shikanoin Heizou - Act I
chapter.title: Trap 'Em by Storm

dialogues.speaker: An Approval Reply for "Heizou Talks Fraud"
dialogues.text: Police Station: Your application for the public awareness campaign "Heizou Talks Fraud" has been received. Following review, your station has been authorized to run the performance with Shikanoin Doushin in charge of the related work. — The Headquarters of the Tenryou Commission

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Heizou Talks Fraud"? What's that? Sounds interesting, whatever it is.

dialogues.speaker: "Case of the Missing Eastern Express"
dialogues.text: The beloved dog, "Eastern Express," reportedly went missing late in the night. The owner discovered twelve canine footprints of varying sizes in the courtyard, leading to the initial assumption that the crime was carried out by a team...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who would give a dog such a strange name?

dialogues.speaker: "The Prince of Mischief in Hanamizaka"
dialogues.text: There is a slacker who claims to be the "Prince of Mischief" terrorizing Hanamizaka. Children have reportedly been losing valuables in the area, the bulk of which are Onikabuto, Genius Invokation TCG cards, and so on...

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Hmm, let's see who's complaining about me here...

dialogues.speaker: Uesugi
dialogues.text: This is quite unusual. Who could possibly lodge a complaint against Heizou? It's not easy being a Doushin.

dialogues.speaker: Owada
dialogues.text: Interesting. Even Doushin Shikanoin can receive a complaint letter.
